use.t: 每次读取或修改敏感资源，都在服务端检查当前用户

lessonPractice.title: 已登录的普通成员请求删除另一个团队的项目。下一步该判断什么？

options.label: 该用户是否对这一个项目拥有删除权限
options.feedback: 对。身份已知后，还要针对资源和动作判断是否允许。

options.label: 让他重新输入一次密码，只要成功就允许删除
options.feedback: 重新认证不能自动授予原本没有的项目权限。

options.label: 只要前端没有显示删除按钮，就不需要服务端判断
options.feedback: 用户仍可直接构造请求，服务端必须执行权限检查。

en.title: A signed-in member asks to delete a project from another team. What should be checked next?

options.label: Whether this user may delete this specific project
options.feedback: Correct. Once identity is known, permission must be checked for the resource and action.

options.label: Ask for the password again and allow deletion if it succeeds
options.feedback: Re-authentication does not grant a project permission the person lacks.

options.label: Skip a server check if the browser hides the delete button
options.feedback: A request can still be constructed directly, so the server must check authorization.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 删除项目接口只检查了用户是否登录。请增加项目归属或团队角色的服务端权限判断。先让同团队无删除权成员和其他团队成员分别请求同一个仍存在的测试项目，确认都被明确拒绝且项目未变化；最后再由项目所有者删除，并核对记录确实消失。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: The delete-project endpoint checks only whether a user is signed in. Add a server-side ownership or team-role check. First have a same-team member without delete permission and a member of another team request the same existing test project; both must receive an explicit denial and leave it unchanged. Finally delete it as the owner and confirm the record is gone.
